verdict.rationale: Sentry documents background automations that run without a user present. Seer Autofix automatically scans incoming issues to find root causes and automate triage, and can generate a fix and open a PR. Alert rules also act on their own when issues match pre-defined rules, sending notifications, creating tickets or calling webhooks. However, the evidence does not show how users configure or schedule Seer's autonomous runs, and there is no hands-on corroboration, so coverage is incomplete. Missing for 10: documented user setup and controls for Seer's autonomous automations (triggers, thresholds, scheduling), general-purpose user-defined background agent workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage. PR Creation: Use Autofix to generate a code fix and create a PR.
Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules. An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations
